jobDesc: Shipped four paid subscription features on Claude: match suggestions, chat coaching, icebreakers, and bio generation, with a two-tier fallback that keeps them usable when the model fails.

Grew monthly revenue from NT$210K to NT$380K (+81%): built subscription auto-renewal and failed-payment handling, and recovered the true cancellation count that front-end cancellations never wrote back.
Cut monthly cloud spend from US$1,200 to just over US$400 (-60%): routed Rekognition moderation by media type and persisted generated results behind a cache.
Brought peak database connections from 1,162 down to 883 (-24%): shortened the proxy reclaim window and added connection validation and retry.
Took a 5-second recommendation query down to milliseconds, with the API averaging around 180ms: replaced JSON extraction with virtual generated columns and composite indexes, plus layered caching.
Took FCP from 10.0s to 1.4s: replaced a heavy background image and subsetted the CJK webfont.
Delivered the Flutter app, NestJS / TypeScript backend, and Docker deployment single-handedly, including content moderation, sensitive-word filtering, and real-person face verification.
Led 11 engineers through 12 products; the design review and code review I introduced became the standard reused across products.
Cut deployment defects and release mistakes by 70%: established a release checklist and a standardized release process.
Improved how quickly the team isolates problems by 50%: defined a standard troubleshooting sequence.

Held up betting and order traffic of roughly a thousand requests per second during draw windows and peak hours: Kafka for cross-service event streams, Redis and Bull Queue for caching and asynchronous settlement.
Owned backend architecture and technical decisions for several game and platform products across real-time, asynchronous, and high-concurrency scenarios.
Built backend services in Node.js / TypeScript, tuned MySQL performance, designed the Redis caching, and deployed on Linux / Docker.
Built and operated games, lotteries, blockchain fair random numbers, crawler data, and admin dashboards.
Handled system analysis, backend implementation, and performance work, and restructured inherited legacy code into maintainable modules.
Delivered commercial projects including lending systems, a video streaming platform, an equipment repair system, and e-commerce modules.
Owned the core backend and data flow design for the lending system (Node.js / NestJS / MySQL).
Reduced module coupling by separating frontend and backend responsibilities and reworking the API design, and set up unit and functional testing.
